description: Aviation hazards near an airport — Inflight weather hazards around an airport or point: active SIGMETs and convective SIGMETs, G-AIRMETs (IFR, mountain obscuration, turbulence, icing, low-level wind shear), freezing levels and recent pilot reports (turbulence/icing counts, urgent PIREPs, worst reports), with distance in nm and an altitude match. Verdict CLEAR / CAUTION / SIGNIFICANT / AVOID with reasons. Params: airport= ICAO or 3-letter US id (or lat= & lon=), radius_nm= 10-300 (default 100), alt_ft= cruise altitude to filter by, pirep_hours= 1-6 (default 2). Source: NWS Aviation Weather Center (public domain). Advisory only, not an official briefing. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_aviation_hazards
